# Bot Implementation

This folder contains the bot implementation code.

**Source:** Generated by LLM based on specification in `../spec/`.

---

## Structure

```
bot/
├── core/                    # Platform-agnostic core
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── contracts.py         # DTO classes
│   ├── processor.py         # Main pipeline
│   ├── parser/
│   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   └── time_parser.py   # Regex-based time parsing
│   └── timezone/
│       ├── __init__.py
│       ├── extractor.py     # Timezone hint extraction
│       └── converter.py     # Timezone conversion
│
├── adapters/
│   └── telegram/
│       ├── __init__.py
│       ├── adapter.py       # Main adapter
│       ├── event_mapping.py # Telegram → CoreMessageEvent
│       └── formatter.py     # DisplayBlock → text
│
├── data/
│   ├── cities.json          # City whitelist (from spec)
│   └── users.json           # User profiles (create from example)
│
├── configuration.yaml       # Runtime configuration
├── requirements.txt         # Python dependencies
├── env.example              # Environment variables template
└── run.sh                   # Entrypoint script
```

---

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Create virtual environment
python3.10 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate

# 2. Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 3. Configure
cp env.example .env
# Edit .env with your Telegram token

cp data/users.example.json data/users.json
# Edit data/users.json with your user mappings

# 4. Run
./run.sh
```
